tasks.title: Survey GSD
tasks.statement: Altitude **{h} m**, sensor width **{sw} mm**, focal length **{f} mm**, frame width **{w} px**. Find the GSD (cm/px).
tasks.solution: GSD = H·w_sensor/(f·W_px). Units: H in meters, the sensor width and focal length in millimeters cancel out, ×100 converts to centimeters.

tasks.title: Trigger distance from the overlap
tasks.statement: Altitude **{h} m**, field of view along the line **{fov}°**, frontal overlap **{o} %**. Distance between shots (m)?
tasks.solution: Footprint along the line = 2H·tan(FOV/2), distance = footprint·(1 − overlap). This value goes into `DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST`.

tasks.title: Distance between lines
tasks.statement: Altitude **{h} m**, field of view across the line **{fov}°**, side overlap **{o} %**. Distance between lines (m)?
tasks.solution: The same formula in the across direction. The long side of the frame across the line means fewer lines and a shorter mission.
